title: Types of cables for different voltages
headers: Type of Cable to be used
rows: XLPE- Cross Linked, Polyethylene insulated, PVC sheathed Cable
markdown:
| No | Range of Voltage | Type of Cable to be used | IS Ref. |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1. | 1 phase - 230 V | PVC insulated, PVC Sheathed | IS: 1554 |
|  | 3 phase - 415 V |  |  |
| 2. | Up to 6.6 KV | PVC insulated, PVC Sheathed | IS: 1554 |
| 4 | 11 KV 3 phase | XLPE- Cross Linked, Polyethylene insulated, PVC sheathed Cable | IS: 7098 |
| 5 | 1 phase – 230 V | Paper insulated, lead sheathed | IS: 692 |
notes: Printed row numbering is 1., 2., 4, 5: there is no row 3 and no IS reference is printed for it. The gap is retained and not renumbered.
Row 1 prints two voltages in one cell on two lines. The cell is expanded into two rows so that no embedded line break is needed; the Type of Cable and IS Ref. cells apply to both printed lines.
Row 5 prints an en dash in '1 phase – 230 V' while row 1 prints hyphens; both are retained.

transcription.method: Direct visual reading of the annotation-cleaned 144 dpi full-page PNGs and 288-300 dpi region crops, with sideways pages rotated upright before reading; no OCR, no native-text values, no paid service
transcription.observations: First reading only. Every cell, power, dash, blank and footnote was read from the image and retained as printed; printed anomalies are listed in notes and were not corrected.

visual_recheck.method: Distinct parent visual comparison against source-region PNGs and rotated or zoomed crops; not independent human review
visual_recheck.observations: Compared every table cell and formula term; checked footnotes, blank cells, numerical outliers and skipped row numbering. Added No cell rowspan for the two expanded voltage lines of printed row 1.
